proof_body:
by
  intro G _ p q hp hq hpq hmod hc
  haveI : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hq⟩
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hc]; exact Nat.mul_ne_zero hp.ne_zero hq.ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime (G := G) p (n := 1) (by rw [hc, pow_one]; exact dvd_mul_right p q)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime (G := G) q (n := 1) (by rw [hc, pow_one]; exact dvd_mul_left q p)
  rw [pow_one] at hA hB
  have hiA : A.index = q := by
    have := A.card_mul_index
    rw [hA, hc] at this
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp.pos this
  have hiB : B.index = p := by
    have := B.card_mul_index
    rw [hB, hc, mul_comm p q] at this
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hq.pos this
  have hBn : B.Normal := by
    apply Subgroup.normal_of_index_eq_minFac_card
    rw [hiB, hc]
    have hne : p * q ≠ 1 := by have := hp.two_le; have := hq.two_le; nlinarith
    have hmp := Nat.minFac_prime hne
    rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hmp).1 (Nat.minFac_dvd (p * q)) with h | h
    · exact ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hmp hp).1 h).symm
    · have h1 := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hmp hq).1 h
      have h2 := Nat.minFac_le_of_dvd hp.two_le (dvd_mul_right p q)
      omega
  let P : Sylow p G := Sylow.ofCard A (by rw [hA, hc, Nat.factorization_mul hp.ne_zero hq.ne_zero]; simp [hp.factorization, hq.factorization, hpq.ne'])
  have hcount : Nat.card (Sylow p G) = 1 := by
    have h1 : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p] := card_sylow_modEq_one p G
    have h2 : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ q := by
      have := P.card_dvd_index
      rwa [show (P : Subgroup G) = A from rfl, hiA] at this
    rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hq).1 h2 with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at h1; exact absurd h1 hmod
  have hAn : A.Normal := by
    haveI : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) := (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 hcount).1
    exact P.normal_of_subsingleton
  have hdis : Disjoint A B := Subgroup.disjoint_of_coprime_natCard (by rw [hA, hB]; exact (Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).2 hpq.ne)
  obtain ⟨x, hxA⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := A) p (by rw [hA])
  obtain ⟨y, hyB⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := B) q (by rw [hB])
  have hcomm : Commute (x : G) (y : G) := Subgroup.commute_of_normal_of_disjoint A B hAn hBn hdis x y x.2 y.2
  have hxo : orderOf (x : G) = p := by rw [Subgroup.orderOf_coe, hxA]
  have hyo : orderOf (y : G) = q := by rw [Subgroup.orderOf_coe, hyB]
  apply isCyclic_of_orderOf_eq_card ((x : G) * (y : G))
  rw [hcomm.orderOf_mul_eq_mul_orderOf_of_coprime (by rw [hxo, hyo]; exact (Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).2 hpq.ne), hxo, hyo, hc]
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (p q : ℕ), p.Prime → q.Prime → p < q → ¬ q ≡ 1 [MOD p] → Nat.card G = p * q → IsCyclic G
